_note: Pin of the B1 base-state readback producer (RTC-SV-CHANGE-BASE-STATE-READBACK-014, StegVerse-Labs/.github draft PR 3266). The producer runs git, so P4 does not vendor it or execute it in admission (receipt fixtures were produced by running the pinned bytes unmodified outside this repo, see fixtures[].produced_by); admission_predicate.py consumes only its sealed receipt (--base-state-receipt), verifies it as TVC#519 @fe768899 sv_change_base_state.base_state_from_readback does (only an ALLOW binds; a DENY readback is BASE_STATE_NOT_OBSERVED; a void shape (P1 @e65ee21b readback_shape_violation: no cross_checked, an hb_epoch_cross_check key, or a non-canonical marker), is FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED under READBACK_SHAPE_MATCHES_PINNED_PRODUCER, ruling 17:07Z), and judges the epoch as P1 verify_admission_hb_epoch does. git_blob_sha and sha256 verified against bytes fetched at PR head 7ad6d81f on 2026-10-19 (confirmed the PR's current head; re-pinned from 9c9b9f51). The producer always emits top-level cross_checked (P1 NOT_CROSS_CHECKED_MARKER amended ~17:15Z): omitted --hb-epoch ALLOW = cross_checked false + detail HB_EPOCH_NOT_CROSS_CHECKED; cross-checked ALLOW and DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH = cross_checked true + supplied_hb_epoch; FAIL_CLOSED = cross_checked false (+ supplied_hb_epoch when given); explicit '', 'null' or UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED is FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED; other malformed or differing is DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH.
hb_epoch_slot: observed: the epoch on the org-ledger head receipt the base is bound to ($.hb_reference.epoch), sealed with hb_epoch_source {ledger_head, receipt, field}; HB_EPOCH_SUPPLIED takes it only when hb_epoch_source.ledger_head == base_ref.ledger_head (ADMISSION_HB_EPOCH_IS_THE_BOUND_LEDGER_HEAD_EPOCH); a contradicting or invalid --hb-epoch is DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH
